connector.name: MindFlows
connector.registryDescription: Visual workflow memory: search, read, and freeze MindFlows workflows from any agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mindflows.us over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace us.mindflows, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <MindFlows API key>. Alternative to OAuth for headless clients. Generate one in Settings → Integrations at mindflows.us.
